title: Peace activists Aziz Abu Sarah and Maoz Inon: 'The first step toward a shared society is to learn the other's narrative'

title: Searching for Ingmar Bergman's soul on Sweden's Fårö island
subhead: Captivated by the stark beauty of its landscapes, Bergman lived on the small Baltic island and filmed several of his movies there until his death in 2007. Starting at age 60, he also gathered his nine children – born to six different women – at his home on the island. Today, they continue to honor his memory there.
